ns2:section.sectionText: This research and writing course is for anthropology majors who are completing their Senior Capstone requirement. Working closely with a faculty advisor and the course instructors, this seminar provides anthropology seniors with opportunities to improve the quality of their Senior Capstone Project through in-depth preparation. Students will strengthen their writing, analytic, and research skills for doing library/online, ethnographic, laboratory and/or field research in their chosen sub-field(s) of anthropology. Students will normally register for this course in the fall of their senior year.
